sentences.text: In short: VILLA GABEL VBN AS is an established company in "pr og kommunikasjonstjenester" based in Oslo, profitable in 2025.
VILLA GABEL VBN AS is registered in the industry "Pr og kommunikasjonstjenester"; its registered activity is "Markedsføringstjenester og næringslivsmesser".
VILLA GABEL VBN AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2013-01-23, registered in Oslo.
It had 2 full-time equivalents (2025 annual accounts), reported revenue of NOK 6.70M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 104,080 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 1.6% and a strong equity ratio of 46% of total assets.

Revenue fell 1.1% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 6.77M to NOK 6.70M); it was NOK 6.33M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 541,122, 2024: NOK 70,389, 2025: NOK 84,536).
VILLA GABEL VBN AS is led by Jørn Ellingsen, who is both CEO and board chair.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2022-05-05.
VILLA GABEL VBN AS has 1 registered workplace.
